questions.q: What is the difference between `JSON.serialize()` and `JSON.serializePretty()`?
options: serializePretty() only works on sObjects, not wrapper classes
They produce the same data, but serializePretty() adds indentation for readability
serialize() is deprecated in favor of serializePretty()
serializePretty() returns a Map, while serialize() returns a String
questions.explain: Both convert an Apex object to JSON; serializePretty() simply formats the output with indentation, useful for reading rather than transmitting.

questions.q: What is required of a class used as the target type for `JSON.deserialize(json, MyClass.class)`?
options: It must extend Exception
It needs public (or global) fields whose names match the JSON keys being parsed
It must implement Database.Batchable
It must be declared as an enum
questions.explain: JSON.deserialize() maps JSON keys onto matching public/global field names on the target class to populate an instance of it.

questions.q: What data type does every numeric value come back as after parsing with `JSON.deserializeUntyped()`?
options: Integer, always
Double, always
Decimal, regardless of whether the original JSON number had a decimal point
It varies unpredictably depending on the value
questions.explain: deserializeUntyped() always returns numeric values as Decimal, which is why casting to (Decimal) and then converting further if needed (e.g. intValue()) is the expected, correct pattern.

questions.q: When should you prefer `JSON.deserializeUntyped()` over `JSON.deserialize()` with a known class?
options: Always — deserializeUntyped is strictly better in every case
When consuming JSON whose exact shape isn't fully known or controlled, such as a response from an external system
Only when the JSON contains no nested objects
Never — deserializeUntyped is deprecated
questions.explain: deserializeUntyped is the right tool when the incoming JSON's shape isn't fully known ahead of time, parsing it into generic Map/List structures you navigate yourself.

questions.q: In the HTTP callout example, what does `JSON.deserializeUntyped(res.getBody())` do?
options: Sends a new HTTP request to res.getBody()'s URL
Parses the raw JSON text of the HTTP response body into generic Map/List structures for further navigation
Automatically inserts the response data as new Account records
Converts the response into an XML document instead of JSON
questions.explain: res.getBody() returns the raw response text, and deserializeUntyped parses that JSON text into nested Map/List structures the calling code can then read field by field.
